name: L3HARRIS TECHNOLOGIES INTEGRATED SYSTEMS L.P.
naics_description: OTHER AIRCRAFT PARTS AND AUXILIARY EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING
brief_text:
Four detectors flagged L3Harris Technologies Integrated Systems. Benford's Law analysis of leading digits in award amounts showed a statistically significant deviation from expected frequency patterns. Modification growth on a single Air Force contract grew at an extraordinary rate compared to peer manufacturers. An Isolation Forest multivariate analysis identified the entity as a statistical outlier based on its portfolio characteristics. Finally, sole-source award concentration substantially exceeded industry norms for aircraft parts manufacturing.

The Benford test yielded a p-value of 0.025 across 340 transactions, with observed digit-1 frequency of 27 percent versus expected 30 percent. The modification growth detector found a z-score of 47.4 on contract FA862021G4027, where modifications grew at a ratio of 48,585 compared to a peer median of 74. The Isolation Forest score was 0.825 on a 0-to-1 scale. Sole-source awards comprised 94 percent of the entity's 340 total awards, yielding a z-score of 1.25 against a peer median of 45 percent.

These signals reflect statistical anomalies rather than confirmed fraud. L3Harris is a large, established defense contractor with over 10 billion dollars in lifetime obligations, which may explain some outlier characteristics. The single-agency concentration and high modification frequency are consistent with long-term prime contractor relationships on major programs. The peer group for sole-source comparison includes 328 manufacturers, though industry consolidation may limit true comparability. Benford deviations at p=0.025 warrant attention but remain borderline.
